messages:
Maria P (Product): FYI — SilverBirch is pushing a hard commitment: private VPC + enterprise SLA (99.95) for their production rollout. Sales says target GA date Oct 15. We need to decide scope (phased vs full) and sign-off criteria. @Sam L can you confirm what was promised?

Sam L (Sales): Yep, told them we'd aim for mid-Oct if we can guarantee network isolation + KMS + audit logs. They're asking for per-region deployment and IP allowlist. :grimacing:

Priya S (Customer Success): SilverBirch legal flagged encryption at rest w/ customer-managed keys (KMS) and a SOC2 audit log requirement. They want a sign-off doc and a 2-week beta window with their infra team.

Jian K (Eng): Rough feasibility note: Private control plane + KMS + basic audit logging + IP allowlist = ~6-8 weeks if we can reuse existing Dedicated infra + config templates. Per-region deployment and on-prem package adds another 4-6 weeks. Blockers: capacity quota and HSM/KMS integration testing.

Leo T (CTO): Proposal: do a phased delivery
- Phase 1 (MVP, Oct 15 target): VPC peering, customer-managed KMS integration (cloud KMS), basic audit logs, IP allowlist, SLA doc (99.9 -> negotiable)
- Phase 2 (Nov/Dec): per-region pools, on-prem package, HSM/HSM-backed KMS, extended SLA 99.95

Maria P (Product): Acceptance criteria for Phase 1 (what we need to ship by Oct 15):
- Private VPC connectivity validated with customer
- KMS workflow documented and tested with SilverBirch devs
- Audit logs available in console + exported to their SIEM
- Signed addendum (scope, SLA, data controls)
- On-call rotation & runbook for SilverBirch incidents

Jian K (Eng): Can commit to Phase 1 if Sales locks a rollout date this week and infra quota is cleared. We'll need one dedicated SRE pair for the beta and 2 weeks of integration testing.

Sam L (Sales): I can confirm we will get signature on addendum by EOW if we promise Phase 1 deliverables. Will also push for a 6-month pilot commitment from them (gone over the price).

Priya S (Customer Success): I'll schedule the 2-week beta window with SilverBirch starting Oct 1 — need the infra to be ready by then. Also need a short checklist for their security review.

Maria P (Product): Action items:
- @Jian K: produce a small scope doc + runbook for Phase 1 by Tue (owner: Eng)
- @Priya S: send beta invite + security checklist to SilverBirch by Fri (owner: CS)
- @Sam L: secure signed addendum by EOW and confirm pilot commitment (owner: Sales)
- @Leo T: approve resource allocation (1 SRE pair) and infra quota by Mon (owner: Exec)

infra-bot: deploy note: Reserved GPU pool quota request submitted (req-3345). Status: pending.

Jian K (Eng): Putting a short config snippet we'll use for the beta (not final):
```
redwood.conf:
  deployment_mode: private
  vpc: peer-abc123
  kms: customer-kms
  audit_export: splunk://sbx.splunk.example
```

Maria P (Product): Thanks all. If we agree to the phased approach and Sales gets the addendum EOW, we'll mark this as "customer-driven priority" on the roadmap and align a small cross-functional launch squad.

Sam L (Sales): Sounds good. I'll ping once signed. :thumbsup:

Priya S (Customer Success): noted. I'll start docs.

Leo T (CTO): Fine with the approach. Eskalations: if infra quota isn't cleared by Mon, we re-evaluate target dates.

Maria P (Product): Closing notes: we'll reconvene Wed 11am to approve the Phase 1 scope doc. If anything changes, update thread.
